messages:

Subject: Request: Full purge workflow + confirmation for FinMate integration

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing for an audit next month and need a clear, actionable workflow for a customer-initiated purge that covers: prompt inputs, model outputs, and all inference logs (request/response, KV cache traces, rollout routing logs). Specifically we need:

- A reproducible playbook your ops team will run (steps + expected timing)
- Confirmation evidence we can present to our legal/audit folks (what artifacts you provide and their format)
- An SLA for turnaround (preferably <= 72 hours) and escalation path if evidence is incomplete

Can you send a single-thread checklist + sample confirmation email we can expect once the purge completes? We need this for our SOC roadmap.

Thanks,
Lucas Moreno
Head of Integrations, FinMate
sec-team@finmate.com

Hi Lucas —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a working checklist (erasure-checklist-v1.xlsx) and below is the high-level workflow we propose. We can commit to a 72-hour target for standard erasure requests originating from your account, with a 24-hour notification window when scheduling is needed for Reserved/Dedicated capacity.

High-level steps (ops playbook):
1) Intake & validation (0–4 hrs): confirm account id, scope (prompts, outputs, logs), and any preservation hold flags.
2) Snapshot & pre-check (4–8 hrs): create cryptographically hashed snapshot of current artifacts for internal audit retention (retention marker only; contents are not released).
3) Execution (8–48 hrs): run targeted deletion routines across: prompt input store, prompt-output persistence, request/response logs, and short-term KV eviction; include cache invalidation and index updates.
4) Audit extraction (48–60 hrs): generate redacted audit snippet showing object IDs removed, timestamps, and deletion confirmation codes.
5) Confirmation & close (60–72 hrs): send signed confirmation email + links to audit snippet and playbook log.

We typically produce:
- A PDF audit snippet (redacted) showing object ids + deletion hashes
- A CSV manifest with deleted record ids (redacted where necessary)
- A signed confirmation email with an internal reference id

Next steps: I can schedule an ops dry-run with our infra team next week and share sample outputs. Laura and Neha are cc'd to add any legal/compliance constraints.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Thanks — this looks good. Two clarifying items:

1) For the "Snapshot & pre-check" step, can you confirm the retention period for the snapshot hashes Redwood keeps after the purge? Our audit wants evidence that the company retains only proof-of-deletion—not the raw prompt/output contents.

2) Can you provide an example of the signed confirmation email format (we want to store it as evidence in our compliance binder)?

If we can get those two items, we can close this ticket on our side and move the request to scheduling.

—Lucas

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Lucas Moreno <lucas@finmate.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T12:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full purge workflow + confirmation for FinMate integration

Hi Lucas —

Quick answers:
- Snapshot retention: We keep only a cryptographic proof record (hash, deletion reference id, and minimal metadata such as timestamp and object-type flags) for a period of 12 months for auditability. The proof record cannot be reversed to reconstruct prompt or output content.
- Example confirmation: see the template below (we will attach a signed PDF after execution).

--- example confirmation template ---
From: Redwood Inference <ops@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Moreno <lucas@finmate.com>
Date: {{execution_time}}
Subject: Confirmation of secure erasure — FinMate (request {{request_id}})

Hello Lucas,

This is to confirm that Redwood Inference has completed the secure erasure of prompted inputs, model outputs, and associated inference logs scoped to FinMate request {{request_id}}. Scope: prompt-store, prompt-output persistence, request/response logs, and short-term KV cache entries.

Evidence provided:
- redacted-audit-snippet-{{request_id}}.pdf (contains deleted object IDs and deletion hashes)
- deleted-manifest-{{request_id}}.csv (list of record ids removed; PII redacted)
- internal-deletion-log-{{request_id}}.txt (ops-run trace for Redwood use only)

Retention of proof-records: cryptographic deletion proofs are retained for 12 months only for regulatory audit purposes.

If you require a notarized statement or custom wording for your binder, please let us know.

Regards,
Redwood Inference — Data Operations
---

We can produce the signed PDF and the redacted audit snippet as attachments after the job completes.

Neha Kapoor
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
